title: Scale agents securely with IAM Helper Agent Skills and MCP Tools

title: SDK drift detected 2026-10-27
quote: Go batch-settlement now supports extra.voucherManager: "facilitator" with delegated refunds, facilitator voucher storage, managed pass-through servers, and ERC-8021 charge-count attestation. TypeScript and Python still only implement server-held voucher custody, so facilitator-managed EVM batch channels cannot be operated end-to-end outside Go.

title: feat(go): facilitator-managed voucher custody for EVM batch settlement
quote: EVM batch-settlement can now let the facilitator hold the vouchers. The resource server checks each payment and forwards it; the facilitator stores the voucher, claims, settles, and refunds. The old mode, where the server holds the vouchers, stays the default.

title: @coinbase/cdp-sdk depends on zod 3, which has an unfixed high advisory (GHSA-mrhx-c7xc-m3w5)
quote: Because cdp-sdk is pulled in by @coinbase/x402 and the x402 facilitator setup, every x402 seller using the CDP facilitator now fails npm audit, and npm audit fix suggests a downgrade to @coinbase/x402@0.0.0, which breaks payments.

title: 1.59.0 lazy x402 loading still breaks bundlers: x402/account-signers.js statically imports @x402/evm
quote: Bundlers still follow dynamic imports, so this module ends up in the build. When the optional peer is not installed, Vite 8 (Rolldown) replaces it with an empty placeholder module and fails.
